2026 double winners! FC Bayern clinched the DFB Cup with victory over VfB Stuttgart in the final. After winning the Bundesliga title, Vincent Kompany’s side can now celebrate the club’s first double since 2020. It’s the richly deserved reward for an exceptional season.
